I used the following prompt.

```
sgpt "In R, generate 32 random numbers from 2 to 13 with replacement
      but with the constraint that any given number may be repeated
      no more than three times and no fewer than twice"
```

The output went up to the line that begins with three hashtags, then I manually added the remainder to make it look better.

```{r}
 set.seed(123) # For reproducibility

 # Initialize the vector
 numbers <- c()

 # Ensure each number appears at least twice
 for (i in 2:13) {
   numbers <- c(numbers, rep(i, 2))
 }

 # Calculate remaining slots
 remaining_slots <- 32 - length(numbers)

 # Randomly select numbers to fill remaining slots,
 #   ensuring no number appears more than 3 times
 while (remaining_slots > 0) {
   num <- sample(2:13, 1)
   if (sum(numbers == num) < 3) {
     numbers <- c(numbers, num)
     remaining_slots <- remaining_slots - 1
   }
 }

 # Shuffle the numbers
 numbers <- sample(numbers)

 # Print the result
 print(numbers)

#.### my additions follow here

p <- as_tibble(cbind(names,numbers))
p$numbers <- parse_number(p$numbers)
p |> arrange(numbers) |> print(n=32)
```
